name: Turn blog posts into LinkedIn videos, X teasers and share images with Zvid

parameters.content:
## Turn a blog article into a social content kit

### How it works
For content marketers: read the newest RSS article, fetch its text, and ask OpenRouter for concise copy grounded in that source. Zvid produces a square LinkedIn video, a landscape X teaser and an Open Graph image. Assets render one at a time. Review the returned files before publishing; social posting is not included.

### Setup
1. Install **@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL **https://api.zvid.io**. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect an **OpenRouter API** credential to **Write kit copy**. In **Config**, replace **feedUrl**, **brandName**, **domainOverride** and the call to action. Use a public article page and an accessible music URL.
4. Choose outputs with **makeLinkedInVideo**, **makeXTeaser** and **makeOgImage**. Keep at least one enabled.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits; AI may charge separately. Optional **dryRun=true** returns drafts and quotes when the installed Zvid node exposes **Project → Create**.
6. Test manually and inspect every asset before enabling the daily schedule. The last-post marker persists only on production executions.

### Customization
Adjust colors, fonts, timing and output toggles in Config. [Full setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/blog-content-kit.md).

nodes.name: Section 1 - Select the newest unused article

parameters.content:
## 1. Select the newest unused article

Set your feed and branding in Config. The daily trigger runs at 9am in the workflow timezone; production runs skip the last completed post, while manual tests can rebuild it.

nodes.name: Section 2 - Write copy from the source

parameters.content:
## 2. Write copy from the source

Fetch the article page, falling back to RSS text when needed. OpenRouter returns short copy for the three formats; check the claims against the article before sharing.

nodes.name: Section 3 - Build and validate each asset

parameters.content:
## 3. Build and validate each asset

Check background music availability and size. Build the enabled formats, then validate each design and credit quote before submitting any render.

## 4. Preview or render

The default false branch renders. For dryRun=true, the draft branch requires Project → Create support in the installed Zvid node and returns editor links with a quote; AI may still charge.

nodes.name: Section 5 - Render one piece at a time

parameters.content:
## 5. Render one piece at a time

Each accepted asset finishes before the next submission. Only explicit rate-limit rejections retry after a delay; timeoutMinutes bounds retries and polling. Check the existing Zvid job before rerunning a timeout.

nodes.name: Section 6 - Review videos and the share image

parameters.content:
## 6. Review videos and the share image

Run summary returns each completed link and records the post after the kit finishes. Open Watch video → Binary → data → View; select each item. Videos play as MP4s and the PNG opens as an image.
